description:
NOTE:  Once this policy is Enabled or Disabled, setting it back to Not Configured has NO EFFECT.

Cleans out registry keys in the HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE hive that refer to a users SID.

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Apps\CleanupInvalidSessions
Type:  DWORD
Values: 0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled
